description: The case-level "on" routes every statement that names no target (WA24: the vocabulary was registered and wired but no spec ran it; the interpreter unit test pins the routing, nothing proved it end to end through `chainbench run`). The assertion is discriminating on purpose: admin_wemixInfo.self.name is the ONE answer that differs per node, so if the default were ignored and the step fell back to nodes[0] it would read "node1" and fail. A blockNumber or peerCount check would pass either way and prove nothing -- which is exactly how a silently ignored default survives.
